## Modules

- [CliSubprocessCore](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.md): Public entrypoints for the shared CLI subprocess runtime foundation.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Application](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Application.md): OTP application supervision tree for the core runtime.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Channel](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Channel.md): Generic long-lived CLI IO channel above the raw session layer.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Channel.Delivery](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Channel.Delivery.md): Stable mailbox-delivery metadata for direct channel subscribers.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Command](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Command.md): Normalized subprocess invocation data shared by provider profiles.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Command.Options](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Command.Options.md): Validated command-lane options for provider-aware one-shot execution.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Command.RunResult](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Command.RunResult.md): Core-owned result for provider-aware one-shot command execution.

- [CliSubprocessCore.CommandSpec](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.CommandSpec.md): Resolved subprocess program plus any argv prefix that must precede provider
arguments.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Event](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Event.md): Normalized runtime event envelope emitted by the core session layer.

- [CliSubprocessCore.ExecutionSurface](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ExecutionSurface.md): Backward-compatible execution-surface facade for downstream CLI packages.
- [CliSubprocessCore.JSONRPC](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.JSONRPC.md): JSON-RPC helper on top of `CliSubprocessCore.ProtocolSession`.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ModelInput](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ModelInput.md): Normalizes mixed model input into one authoritative model payload.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry.md): Canonical model resolution, validation, and argument payload construction.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry.Model](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry.Model.md): Canonical model metadata loaded by `CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry`.

- [CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry.Selection](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry.Selection.md): Resolved model selection returned by `CliSubprocessCore.ModelRegistry`.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Ollama](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Ollama.md): Ollama HTTP integration used by model validation and backend resolution.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.md): Namespace for the normalized runtime payload structs emitted by the core.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ApprovalRequested](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ApprovalRequested.md): Represents an approval request emitted by a provider CLI.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ApprovalResolved](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ApprovalResolved.md): Represents an approval decision.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.AssistantDelta](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.AssistantDelta.md): Represents a streamed assistant delta.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.AssistantMessage](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.AssistantMessage.md): Represents a completed assistant message.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.CostUpdate](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.CostUpdate.md): Represents token and cost accounting updates.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Error](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Error.md): Represents a normalized runtime error.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Raw](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Raw.md): Represents an unnormalized raw provider payload.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Result](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Result.md): Represents the terminal result of a provider CLI run.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.RunStarted](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.RunStarted.md): Marks the start of a provider CLI run.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Stderr](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Stderr.md): Represents stderr output emitted by a provider CLI.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Thinking](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.Thinking.md): Represents provider thinking output.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ToolResult](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ToolResult.md): Represents a tool invocation result.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ToolUse](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.ToolUse.md): Represents a tool invocation request.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Payload.UserMessage](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Payload.UserMessage.md): Represents normalized user input.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ProtocolAdapter](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProtocolAdapter.md): Pure codec and protocol-state boundary used by `CliSubprocessCore.ProtocolSession`.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ProtocolSession](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProtocolSession.md): Generic protocol-session runtime above `CliSubprocessCore.Channel`.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderCLI](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderCLI.md): Shared provider-specific CLI resolution policies for the core runtime.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderFeatures](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderFeatures.md): Canonical provider feature metadata for the built-in CLI profiles.
- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfile](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfile.md): Behaviour contract for built-in and external provider CLI profiles.

- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Amp](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Amp.md): Built-in provider profile for the common Amp CLI runtime.

- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Claude](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Claude.md): Built-in provider profile for the common Claude CLI runtime.

- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Codex](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Codex.md): Built-in provider profile for the common Codex CLI runtime.

- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Gemini](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderProfiles.Gemini.md): Built-in provider profile for the common Gemini CLI runtime.

- [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderRegistry](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderRegistry.md): Registry of provider profile modules available to the core runtime.

- [CliSubprocessCore.RawSession](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.RawSession.md): Provider-agnostic handle for long-lived raw subprocess sessions.
- [CliSubprocessCore.RawSession.Delivery](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.RawSession.Delivery.md): Stable mailbox-delivery metadata for raw-session consumers.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Runtime](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Runtime.md): Runtime state helpers for normalized session event emission.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Schema](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Schema.md): Canonical schema helpers and shared validation error types for common-lane
dynamic boundaries.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Session](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Session.md): Common CLI session runtime above the raw transport layer.

- [CliSubprocessCore.Session.Delivery](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Session.Delivery.md): Stable mailbox-delivery metadata for direct session subscribers.
- [CliSubprocessCore.Session.Options](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Session.Options.md): Validated startup options for the common session engine.

- [CliSubprocessCore.TaskSupport](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.TaskSupport.md): Small task helpers shared by the runtime and transport layers.

- [CliSubprocessCore.TestSupport.FakeSSH](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.TestSupport.FakeSSH.md): Canonical fake-SSH parity harness for exercising the real execution-surface
path without injecting fake transport implementations.
- [CliSubprocessCore.TestSupport.LiveSSH](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.TestSupport.LiveSSH.md): Shared env-driven helpers for opt-in live SSH execution-surface tests.

- Exceptions
  - [CliSubprocessCore.Command.Error](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.Command.Error.md): Structured failures for the provider-aware non-PTY command lane.

  - [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderCLI.Error](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderCLI.Error.md): Exception returned when provider CLI resolution fails.

  - [CliSubprocessCore.ProviderCLI.ErrorRuntimeFailure](https://cli-subprocess-core.hexdocs.pm/CliSubprocessCore.ProviderCLI.ErrorRuntimeFailure.md): Structured provider CLI runtime failure.
